Zophiel (white hair): She loves Seraphine but confuses her love with hatred, instead wishing for Seraphine's death. She ends up killing Seraphine which leaves her feeling empty.

Seraphine (green hair): She is possessive of Zophiel and is blinded by love. She is jealous of everything and everyone that captures Zophiel's attention. In the end, she is killed by Zophiel.
